analytical_matrix_macs.method: Analytical, 1 multiply-accumulate = 2 FLOPs, per patch; weights shared across 2 executed attention calls
analytical_matrix_macs.includes: Dense/SplineLinear/QKV/attention score/value matrix products; recurrent matrices at all N time steps
analytical_matrix_macs.excludes: RBF exp/basis arithmetic, LayerNorm, softmax, sigmoid/swish, biases, gating/additions; NOT total FLOPs

tf_graph_profile.method: tf.compat.v1.profiler float_operation, frozen inference graph, batch=1
tf_graph_profile.limitations: Control-flow bodies may be undercounted; graph profiling also omits some non-MAC operations. Do not cite as exact FLOPs.
